fact: On or around 15 May 2023 the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources stopped processing change-of-ownership and mortgage transactions while it migrated from ZILMIS to ZILAS, the system for recording and processing land transactions, to be implemented at head office and all provincial offices.
title: New System and Delay of Processing of Transactions at the Lands and Deeds Registry (Memorandum to Clients, Issue No. 202305)
